import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MOD2 = 1007681537;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final long LINF = (long) 1e18;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1);
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final int maxn = 1000005;
    
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fac = new int[maxn];
    static int[] ifac = new int[maxn];
    static int[][] dp = new int[2][maxn];
    static int[] f = new int[maxn];
    
    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        long r;
        while (b != 0) {
            r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }
    
    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
    
    static long fpow(long n, long k, int mod) {
        long r = 1;
        for (; k > 0; k >>= 1) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                r = r * n % mod;
            }
            n = n * n % mod;
        }
        return r;
    }
    
    static void addmod(int[] a, int idx, int val, int mod) {
        if ((a[idx] = (a[idx] + val)) >= mod) {
            a[idx] -= mod;
        }
    }
    
    static void submod(int[] a, int idx, int val, int mod) {
        if ((a[idx] = (a[idx] - val)) < 0) {
            a[idx] += mod;
        }
    }
    
    static int mult(int a, int b, int mod) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % mod);
    }
    
    static int inv(int a, int mod) {
        return (int) fpow(a, mod - 2, mod);
    }
    
    static int sign(double x) {
        return x < -EPS ? -1 : (x > +EPS ? 1 : 0);
    }
    
    static int sign(double x, double y) {
        return sign(x - y);
    }
    
    static int bitcount(long n) {
        return Long.bitCount(n);
    }
    
    static int bit(long n, int i) {
        return (int) (((n >> i) & 1));
    }
    
    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, int invert) {
        int k = 0;
        int temp = n;
        while (temp > 1) {
            k++;
            temp >>= 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if ((bit(msk, i) == 1)) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (invert == 0) {
                        addmod(a, msk, a[pmsk], p);
                    } else {
                        submod(a, msk, a[pmsk], p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int[] pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) {
            return a.clone();
        } else if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (int) ((long) r[i] * a[j] % p)) % p;
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (int) ((long) r[i] * r[j] % p)) % p;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
    
    static int[] subset_pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        final int logn = 19;
        int[][] fa = new int[logn][1 << logn];
        int[][] fb = new int[logn][1 << logn];
        int[][] fc = new int[logn][1 << logn];
        int n = a.length;
        while (n != (n & -n)) {
            n += n & -n;
        }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (bitcount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            va = pow_convol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (bitcount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        int nn = n;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if (bit(n, j) == 1) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= bit(i, j);
                    }
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < maxn; i++) {
            fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }
        int[] a = new int[nn + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) {
            a[i] = ifac[f[i]];
        }
        int res = (int) fpow(k, n, p);
        a = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p);
        submod(new int[]{res}, 0, mult(a[nn], fac[n], p), p);
        System.out.println(res);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
